question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Skia Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native arrays; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Shadow Hound Chase 4x Skill1 + 1x Skill2 + 1x Skill3, The Pack 1x UltraSkill1 Spread + 3x UltraSkill2 Converge, shadow hound gnaw or clone behavior.
decision: Shadow Hound Chase describes 6 instances totaling Quad Strike (30%*4) + Dive (4.6%+25.4%), matching native Skill1 (4 hits), Skill2 (1 hit), and Skill3 (1 hit). The Pack describes 1 Spread instance (290.2%) plus 3 Converge instances (69.9%*3), matching native UltraSkill1 (1 hit) and UltraSkill2 (3 hits). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children once after admission with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; A2 crit rate buff and status application callbacks trigger consistently.
timing_hypothesis: skia.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 750/1, 1285/1, 2997/2; Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 4999/2, 4284/1, 9253/2.
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, rejected energy admission and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public two-Skill/one-Burst rotation produces 16 hits and spends 100 energy once; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, shadow clone coordination, Fang Thrust mark consumption and full awakening effects remain pending.
